systems.country_label: sistema integrado de informação policial, mais conhecido por Zulu
systems.owner: Polícia Nacional de São Tomé e Príncipe; equipment from UNFPA (11 laptops and accessories, after five televisions the year before)
systems.tiers: not stated; the inspector-general speaks of the system as being implemented

note: No fact: UNFPA describes the equipment as reinforcing the computerisation of the Zulu system and speaks only of the data the Polícia Nacional collects, treats, analyses and disseminates, above all on gender-based violence, daily, weekly and monthly; it does not say that an esquadra enters a report or a case in Zulu, so the system is classed statistics, as the earlier documents of this country had it. The page prints no date (published 2024-01-25 is a proxy); the laptops themselves are enabling.
